nodes.label: Color System
nodes.rationale: OKLCH color space for consistency, --game-* prefix, hierarchical backgrounds/borders/text, semantic status colors, accent colors for decoration

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: Inter (UI), Rajdhani (display), JetBrains Mono (code), Tailwind scale with custom sizes, weight hierarchy (400-700), WCAG contrast compliance

nodes.label: Spacing System
nodes.rationale: Tailwind 4px base scale, component-specific presets (input/button/card padding), section gaps (28/40px), mobile-first approach

nodes.label: Animation & Motion
nodes.rationale: Duration-fast (150ms) → normal (200ms) → slow (400ms), custom easing (ease-game, ease-bounce), respect prefers-reduced-motion, GPU-accelerated transforms only

nodes.label: Component States
nodes.rationale: Defined states for buttons/inputs/cards (default, hover, active, focus, disabled/error), loading/empty/error state patterns with skeleton/spinners

nodes.label: Responsive Design
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first approach, Tailwind breakpoints (sm:640, md:768, lg:1024, xl:1280, 2xl:1536), responsive containers/grids/typography patterns

nodes.label: Accessibility Design
nodes.rationale: Focus-visible rings, ARIA labels, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, skip links

nodes.label: Dark Mode Implementation
nodes.rationale: Dark-first design for gaming platform, CSS variables for automatic switching, consistent component support
